description: This file defines the LeaveTypeAPI class, which implements CRUD operations for Leave Types in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting leave type data, utilizing various validation rules and integrating with the underlying leave type service. The class is part of the API layer specifically managing 'leave types' within the leave module.

classes.name: LeaveTypeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations and validation for leave types within the leave module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LeaveType by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all leave types, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new LeaveType based on request parameters.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeParams
methods.description: Sets LeaveType entity properties from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule ensuring ID is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint, including filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a leave type.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for leave type creation and update operations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing LeaveType with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a leave type, including ignoring the current entity for unique validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified leave types by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, expecting an array of IDs.
